fixes.explanation: It's true, actually, baker. Verse 9 says, “He guides the humble in what is right and teaches them His way.” Most folks hand you a map and wish you luck. Here the humble get the guiding AND the teaching.

That's it, baker! Verse 10 says, “All the LORD’s ways are loving and faithful to those who keep His covenant and His decrees.” Loving AND faithful, both at once. You know that friend who's super sweet but never shows up? Not the same thing, and David names exactly who gets both.

Yes! Verse 12 says, “Who is the man who fears the LORD? He will instruct him in the path chosen for him.” So the LORD does the teaching, and there's a path chosen for that man. That's a whole lot better than winging it and hoping for the best.
